author: TheColdCrafter
body:
Player - Temptic
Offense - Kill Aura
Evidence - https://youtu.be/4C0W6wk_93Q
He tries to play off hitting me through the wall as corner hitting, but I was on the opposite side of the block and there was no way i was sticking out on the side he was hitting me from. I believe this is enough evidence, but if it isn't I just want this guy to be watched closely, because I strongly believe he has kill aura.

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Hello Cold,

You haven't replied to this report for over two weeks so I assume you don't have any more conclusive evidence that let us punish the player for hacking. I have to agree what Temptic said in the video, sometimes the hitbox of a player is outside of a structure, like the one you were enclosed in. Other players now can hit you from outside the box and eventually kill you.
I hope you understand the reason why the evidence is ultimately insufficient.
But still keep the work up!

The report is denied!

Regards Flo/resepignev :D
